notes: Maritime escalation against a falling oil price. Two UKMTO-confirmed attacks on 16 Nov: Warning 207-26 (~05:58Z) - outbound tanker struck by an unknown projectile, engine-room fire, all crew accounted for, identified by press as ON PHOENIX (IMO 9893228, Panama) ~3 nm off Oman, later seen under tow; and Warning 208-26 (~19:00Z) - a tanker disabled with an engine-room fire ~7 nm north of Khasab, Oman, identified as the Panama-flagged LPG carrier TARA GAS (25 crew, 24 Indian), described by Gulf News/Khaleej Times as a missile attack; at 07:45Z 17 Nov UKMTO relayed a second strike and second fire on the same vessel and Gulf News reported the crew UNACCOUNTED FOR (India's shipping minister had said all safe at ~05:32Z) - the first crew-unaccounted report of the standoff, status unresolved at run time. Iran: IRGC Navy claimed two more tankers mined on the 'southern route' under US guidance; IBTimes/Reuters relay (14:51Z 16 Nov) has Iranian naval forces claiming SIX tankers on fire and sinking since Sunday; Iran Navy (~20:15Z) a 'fourth tanker' mined east of the Strait in 24h; none confirmed - UKMTO wording is 'projectile'/'attack', not 'mine', and no sinking is confirmed by any authority. Sunday's UKMTO 205-26 vessel is now identified as Al Dhannah (IMO 9783734, ADNOC-linked), steering gear damaged. Tue 17 Nov ~07:46Z: explosions in Manama; IRGC claims a drone attack on a US-operated radar at Sheikh Isa Air Base (third Bahrain attack in five days); Bahrain alert 06:58Z, state TV says thwarted. Oil fell anyway: Brent Jan-27 settled 92.44 (-3.40, -3.6%), WTI Dec-26 85.72 (-2.84, -3.2%) on IEA's Q4 1.7 mb/d surplus (Oct stocks +52 mb), Goldman's 2 mb/d 2027 surplus call (Brent ~88 early 2027, 78 by end-2027), DTN ship-tracking showing Middle East crude flows >80% of pre-war (Reuters: 'nearly restored'), the 90-day Jones Act waiver extension and weak China/Europe data; Tue 17 Nov Asia Brent 91.66 at 04:30Z. Hormuz (hormuz.now 21:14Z 16 Nov): 7d avg 7.0/day (49/7d, 8% of 84.8), daily 13 Nov 5, 14 Nov 6, 15 Nov 6, 16 Nov 6 'so far'; tankers 13/7d (1.9/day, 4% of 47.6), 386 tankers/38 VLCC visible, 1,491 vessels; straits.live 36 holding at 17:30Z; JMIC via gCaptain: ~227 commercial vessels stationary at anchorages east of the Strait, 83 US-facilitated transits 12-14 Nov, five attacks off Musandam since 1 Nov. Politics: Vance on Fox (Mon evening) - Trump 'is not going to let this become a forever war', not 'even a two-year commitment', 'we have destroyed the nuclear program', 'he could say we're done now', jabs at 'neoconservatives'; Baghaei (04:01Z 17 Nov) compares Rubio's justification to the Reichstag fire; Araghchi in Muscat 17 Nov after Islamabad ECO, meets Albusaidi - 'constructive', no joint statement; Ghalibaf (05:57Z) says any dam, port or power plant near a US/Israeli base may be treated as 'dual-use'; Kallas after the 16 Nov FAC: EU preparing further Iran sanctions, blames Iran for the Bahrain/Saudi attacks - no Aspides/escort decision found; China MFA re-confirms the 19 Nov Shenzhen trilateral (Iran on agenda per US officials, already recorded); CNN (16 Nov): US intelligence on Iranian option-building to target senior officials with a radiological or chemical device, not 'imminent', unconfirmed by the government. Net: Strait still closed, no US strike, no deal; Iran has escalated at sea (two confirmed attacks in a day, a possible missing crew) and against Bahrain for a third time while Washington's VP publicly bounds the war's duration and the oil market prices surplus over Hormuz.

items.headline: UKMTO Reports Two Tanker Attacks in Strait of Hormuz / Two Tankers Hit Near Strait of Hormuz, One Disabled
items.claim: UKMTO said the company security officer of a tanker reported the vessel 'being struck by an unknown projectile whilst transiting outbound' with a fire in the engine room; 'no casualties have been reported and all crew have been accounted for'; Vanguard Tech/Live-AIS identified the vessel as ON PHOENIX (IMO 9893228, Panama-flagged), ~3 nm off Oman, with Sentinel-2 imagery suggesting it was under tow; UKMTO did not attribute the attack and did not use the word 'mine'.
items.source: gCaptain 16 Nov; Maritime Executive 16 Nov 18:39; ABC live 16 Nov 03:43 EST (UKMTO text); houseofsaud 16 Nov 15:57Z (warning number)
items.note: Occurred ~05:58Z 16 Nov - after the 11-16 run's content but before its 12:11Z run stamp; not in the 11-16 file, kept once with late:true. First of two confirmed attacks on 16 Nov. Iran's 'two more mined' claim the same day is unmatched to this vessel ('unclear' per houseofsaud).

items.name: UKMTO Warning 208-26: tanker disabled with engine-room fire ~7 nm north of Khasab, Oman, ~19:00Z 16 Nov - press identifies LPG carrier TARA GAS (Panama, 25 crew, 24 Indian), 'missile attack'; struck a SECOND time ~07:45Z 17 Nov, crew now reported unaccounted for
items.headline: Iranian Regime attacked Tanker twice Near Oman, Crew Reported Missing / Tanker Attacks Hit Hormuz Shipping as US Weighs Iran Threat
items.claim: UKMTO Warning 208-26 (16 Nov ~19:00Z / 23:00 UAE): a third party reported an attack on a tanker about 7 nm north of Khasab; the vessel was disabled with a fire in the engine room, crew initially reported safe. Gulf News and Khaleej Times identify the Panama-flagged LPG carrier Tara Gas, 'targeted in a missile attack', 25 crew of whom 24 Indian; India's shipping minister Sonowal said ~05:32Z 17 Nov all crew were safe. UKMTO update 07:45Z 17 Nov: a maritime security agency reported a second strike and a second fire on the same vessel; Arab Times and Gulf News (13:39 UAE) report the crew unaccounted for.
items.source: Arab Times 17 Nov 12:35 +03 (09:35Z); houseofsaud 17 Nov 09:49Z (Gulf News relay); Streamline 17 Nov 07:43Z; Gulf News live blog 16-17 Nov; Khaleej Times 17 Nov
items.note: Second confirmed attack of 16 Nov and the first report in the standoff of a crew unaccounted for - crew status conflicts across sources and is unresolved at run time; a confirmed loss of life would be a new category for the M panel. Attribution: press headlines say Iran; UKMTO has not attributed. The ToI-relayed Indian government line and the Omani location (Khasab, Musandam) match JMIC's 'five attacks off Musandam since 1 Nov'.

items.name: Iranian naval forces claim SIX oil tankers 'caught fire and were sinking' since Sunday after mine incidents; IRGC says two more hit mines 'under the direct guidance of US officers'; Reuters cannot confirm - no sinking confirmed by any authority
items.headline: Tanker Struck In Strait Of Hormuz. Iran Claims Six Vessels Are Sinking.
items.claim: IBTimes (16 Nov 14:51Z) relays Iranian naval statements that six oil tankers had caught fire and were sinking since Sunday after striking mines; the IRGC Navy said two tankers hit naval mines crossing the southern Strait while 'under the direct guidance of US officers with US fighter-jet support' (Anadolu); a separate army statement said a tanker east of the Strait hit a mine early Monday and was immobilised; Reuters could not verify the IRGC account and the vessels are unidentified; later Monday (~20:15Z) Iran's navy claimed a 'fourth tanker' in 24 hours.
items.source: IBTimes via Yahoo News 16 Nov 14:51Z; houseofsaud 16 Nov 15:57Z and 17 Nov 09:49Z (Mehr, PressTV, Newsquawk relays)
items.note: Escalation of the claim count from one 'sunk' (15 Nov) to six 'sinking'. Unverified; UKMTO's two confirmed incidents are 'projectile' events. Do not treat as a hard event. Oil fell 3.6% the same session.

items.name: Explosions in Manama ~07:46Z 17 Nov: IRGC claims a drone attack on a US-operated radar at Sheikh Isa Air Base, Bahrain - third attack on Bahrain in five days; Bahrain alert 06:58Z, state TV says barrage thwarted
items.headline: Middle East conflict: Tanker Attack Near Hormuz Amid US Vows Against 'Forever War' (Gulf News live, 17 Nov entries)
items.claim: Gulf News live blog: Bahrain's Interior Ministry issued a threat alert at 10:58 UAE (06:58Z); at 11:46 UAE (07:46Z) explosions were heard in Manama and the IRGC said it launched a drone attack on a US-operated radar at Sheikh Isa Air Base (AFP); Bahrain state TV later said the drone attack was thwarted after an IRGC barrage of UAVs (all-clear entry stamped '11:50', probably 07:50Z). No casualty or damage report and no CENTCOM statement in fetched text.
items.source: Gulf News live blog 17 Nov (AFP); Khaleej Times 17 Nov live page
items.note: Follows the Fri 13 Nov (radar claim, CENTCOM denial) and Sun 15 Nov (six drones at Riffa, intercepted) attacks - a sustained campaign against a Gulf host state rather than a one-off. Kallas (16 Nov) had already blamed Iran for the Bahrain/Saudi attacks. Single live-blog source; CNBC 17 Nov page (client_error) carried 'Iran escalates threats as third US carrier arrives, tanker struck'.

items.name: Vance on Fox (Ingraham, Mon evening): Trump 'is not going to let this become a forever war'... 'not... even a two-year commitment'; 'we have destroyed the nuclear program'; 'he could say, we're done now'; attacks 'neoconservatives and others' who want the US to stay indefinitely
items.headline: Vance says Trump will not allow Iran conflict to become 'forever war' / Vance calls out 'neoconservatives' over Iran war
items.claim: Vice President Vance told Laura Ingraham that 'he is not going to let this become a forever war', 'we told the American people we would do no more forever wars', 'we are not going to allow this to become a 10- or 15-year commitment, or frankly even a two-year commitment', while the Iranian nuclear programme 'is a threat to the United States'; he said he would not call it a war and would not set an 'artificial timeline', that the US has 'destroyed the nuclear program' and 'destroyed Iran's conventional military', that Trump 'could say, we're done now', and that 'neoconservatives and others' want an indefinite stay; he expressed 'full confidence the president will get us out of this thing with great results'. Baghaei (04:01Z 17 Nov) separately compared Rubio's war justification to the Reichstag fire.
items.source: Iran International 16 Nov 22:09Z (verbatim); JNS 17 Nov (summary); Gulf News live 05:05 UAE 17 Nov; Al Jazeera video 17 Nov
items.note: The VP, removed from the Iran file per 12-13 Nov reports, publicly bounding the duration of the campaign and framing objectives as already achieved - an off-ramp signal that sits beside Trump's 'status quo' (15 Nov) and against the third carrier and the Bahrain strikes. No new Trump statement dated 16-17 Nov surfaced.

items.name: Araghchi in Muscat (05:15Z) after Islamabad ECO: meets Omani FM Albusaidi - 'constructive', both reaffirm dialogue for de-escalation; no joint statement, no Hormuz agreement reported
items.headline: Gulf News live: Araghchi arrives in Muscat for official visit; meets Badr Albusaidi
items.claim: Gulf News (citing Mehr) reports Araghchi arrived in Muscat at 09:15 UAE for an official visit following the ECO ministerial in Islamabad, and at 09:40 UAE met Omani Foreign Minister Badr Albusaidi, who called the meeting 'constructive' on X; both sides reaffirmed dialogue for de-escalation. The Oman News Agency (via houseofsaud/AFP) says the talks ended without a joint statement or a Hormuz agreement.
items.source: Gulf News live blog 17 Nov (Mehr); houseofsaud 17 Nov (ONA/AFP relay)
items.note: Oman - the original back-channel venue - re-enters alongside Qatar and Pakistan; Araghchi has now been in Islamabad (16 Nov) and Muscat (17 Nov) in two days. No Witkoff/Qatar item dated 16-17 Nov surfaced; samaa.tv (Araghchi 'confidence in Pakistan's role') client_error.

items.name: Ghalibaf (05:57Z): any dam, port or power plant near a US or Israeli base may be treated as 'dual-use' - applied 'consistently and even-handedly'
items.headline: Gulf News live: Ghalibaf dual-use post on X
items.claim: Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf posted on X that any dam, port or power plant located near a US or Israeli base could be treated as 'dual-use', a standard he said would be applied 'consistently and even-handedly' - read as a threat against Gulf-state civilian infrastructure hosting US forces.
items.source: Gulf News live blog 17 Nov 09:57 UAE
items.note: Pairs with the third Bahrain attack the same morning; names Gulf desalination/power/port infrastructure as legitimate targets in Iran's framing. Single source.

items.name: Kallas after the 16 Nov EU Foreign Affairs Council: EU 'preparing' further Iran sanctions; blames Iran and Yemeni forces for Sunday's attacks on Bahrain and Saudi Arabia - 'increased the risk of renewed war'; no Aspides/escort decision reported
items.headline: EU Preparing Further Sanctions Against Iran, Kallas Says
items.claim: WANA relays Kallas's Brussels press conference after Monday's FAC: the EU is preparing additional sanctions on Iran; she repeated allegations of Iranian involvement in the 11-12 Oct cyberattacks on French store refrigeration systems and accused Iran and Yemen's armed forces of Sunday's attacks on Bahrain and Saudi Arabia, saying they 'increased the risk of renewed war in the region'; Iran's Baghaei called the allegations disinformation. Nothing in the relay on Saudi Arabia's escort/Aspides requests.
items.source: WANA 16 Nov 17:55Z (Iranian state-linked outlet relaying EEAS remarks); EEAS 16 Nov transcript not surfaced
items.note: The Saudi FM's Brussels asks (escorts, executive Aspides mandate - recorded 11-16) produced no reported decision at the 16 Nov FAC; the Defence FAC is 17 Nov. Sanctions track (EU) moving while OFAC's 16-17 Nov actions could not be read. Secondary source; the EEAS page for this FAC was not returned by search.

items.name: CNN: US intelligence indicates Iranian option-building to target senior Trump administration officials in Washington with a radiological ('dirty bomb') or chemical device - seven US officials cited, not described as imminent, not publicly confirmed
items.headline: Gulf News live 03:40 UAE 17 Nov: CNN and other US outlets report Iranian plot intelligence
items.claim: CNN and other US outlets reported Monday 16 Nov that US intelligence points to Iranian plans to target senior administration officials in Washington with a 'dirty bomb' or chemical weapon; seven US officials were cited; the sources characterised it as options-building rather than an imminent attack and the US government has not publicly confirmed it.
items.source: Gulf News live blog 17 Nov 03:40 UAE (CNN relay)
items.note: Domestic-threat reporting that follows the Bessent relocation (11 Nov), the Mossad drone-plot warning (15 Nov) and FPCON CHARLIE at UK bases; relevant to the strike-trigger calculus rather than to Hormuz. Unconfirmed; recorded as a headline, not an event.

items.name: Oil falls 3.6% through two confirmed tanker attacks: IEA Q4 surplus 1.7 mb/d (Oct stocks +52 mb), Goldman 2 mb/d 2027 surplus, DTN ship-tracking shows Middle East crude flows >80% of pre-war, Jones Act waiver extended - 'supply story overtakes Hormuz risk'
items.headline: Oil Down 3%; Supply Surplus Signs Offset Hormuz Worries / Oil settles lower as recovering Middle East exports bolster surplus outlook
items.claim: DTN: Brent Jan-27 settled 92.44 (-3.40) and WTI Dec-26 85.72 (-2.84) as ship-tracking data showed Middle Eastern crude flows had recovered to more than 80% of pre-war levels, the IEA's November report put Q4 supply ~1.7 mb/d above demand, Goldman projected a 2 mb/d surplus in 2027 with Brent ~88 early 2027 and 78 by year-end, the administration extended the Jones Act waiver 90 days, and China's October crude runs fell 8.1% y/y; Reuters: Middle East exports 'nearly restored to pre-war levels'; KCM's Waterer: elevated shipping rates still a floor.
items.source: DTN 16 Nov 2:16pm CST; Reuters via Yahoo 16 Nov; discoveryalert 17 Nov (Kpler ~8.3 mb/d / ANZ ~49% through-Strait context)
items.note: Oil-market-structure headline for the O panel: the market is pricing bypass/re-routing (DTN >80% of pre-war Middle East flows) over the Strait count (hormuz.now 8% of baseline; Kpler 48% through-Strait + STS to 11 Nov) - two different denominators. Brent -3.4% w/w. Not a tell on the standoff itself.
